top_signals.title: Maextro Pledges Brake Redesign as Stock Drops on Test Report
top_signals.summary: Anhui Jianghuai Automobile Group Corp. extended its slump after three vehicles from its flagship luxury brand were depicted in a media test with broken brake-pedal supports, prompting the automaker to pledge a redesign of the component and offer a free upgrade to owners.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
